key_insight: DV-World provides a real-world benchmark of 260 tasks that evaluates data-visualization agents across native environments, cross-platform workflows, and proactive intent alignment — moving beyond sandboxed, single-language, creation-only tests.
problem_solved: Existing DV benchmarks confine agents to code sandboxes, assume perfect user intent, and focus on single-language creation tasks; DV-World addresses these gaps by measuring agent performance across realistic professional lifecycles and environments.
method: Assemble 260 tasks spanning real-world DV lifecycles (creation, editing, alignment, and deployment) across three domains including DV-Sheet for native spreadsheet manipulation
Evaluate agents in native environments and cross-platform scenarios to capture grounding and evolution (not just code generation in isolation)
Introduce tasks requiring proactive intent inference and iterative alignment, plus standardized metrics and protocols for cross-agent comparison
impact: DV-World enables more realistic, actionable evaluation of visualization agents, guiding researchers and engineers to build systems that work reliably in production workflows and better align with user intent.
visual_elements: Workflow diagram showing the DV agent lifecycle: ingest (sheet/dashboard) → create → revise → deploy/monitor
Bar/heatmap comparing agent performance across the three DV-World domains and key task types
Screenshot mockups of native-environment tasks (spreadsheet edits, dashboard adjustments) to illustrate real-world grounding
Radar chart of evaluation dimensions (grounding, cross-platform robustness, intent alignment, usability)
paper_title: DV-World: Benchmarking Data Visualization Agents in Real-World Scenarios
paper_authors: Jinxiang Meng, Shaoping Huang, Fangyu Lei, Jingyu Guo, Haoxiang Liu
